name: crispe-system-architect-plugin
description: Use when asked to analyze a repo, generate STRUCTURE.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / OVERVIEW.md / CLAUDE.md / CONTRIBUTING.md, map architecture, or explain job inputs, outputs and data flows with Mermaid diagrams. 支持分析仓库、梳理项目结构、生成架构文档、说明作业输入输出和流程图；支持中文、English 和中英双语输出。 Also offers documentation before code changes when architecture/context docs are absent. Supports a structure reference, a contribution guide plus structure reference, or an AI context file.
